harness.commit_message: fix(docs): preserve leaf content in LLM copy payload
harness.rationale: The observable copy behavior is implemented in app/docs/layout.tsx, not the issue-named API page. Its DOM walker discarded text in leaf elements nested within styled documentation divs, including endpoint paths and callout content. The edit preserves that leaf text while retaining existing specialized handling for headings, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and tables.
harness.summary: Updated the documentation LLM-copy payload builder to include text from leaf elements nested in styled containers. API documentation endpoint paths, callouts, labels, and other rendered leaf content now remain in the copied abstract alongside the existing structured markdown output.
